count_source: Original GSE181764 released integer gene-expression matrices, before the nuclear-only/200-2000 gene restrictions described in the paper: source matrices retain mitochondrial counts and many low-complexity barcodes. No count correction, imputation, normalization or integration in count deliverables.
cell_calling: No EmptyDrops: every released sample lacks positive-UMI barcodes <=100, so its standard ambient pool is unavailable. Candidates are only provenance/QC/identity-screened released barcodes, not new statistically verified nucleus calls. This uncertainty remains explicit in each object.
author_QC: Paper PMC9555339 describes nuclear-only counts and 200-2000 detected genes. That is not assumed already applied to these released matrices; do not remove MT before recomputing the agreed project MT threshold.
doublet_model: Per released sample, all >=500-gene barcodes including >5000 genes/high MT and all cell types. scDblFinder dbr=NULL,dbr.per1k=.008 only if >=100 model barcodes; otherwise explicitly unscored. Released-candidate count is not known true loading, so inferred rates/calls are screening heuristics, not measured doublet rates.
doublet_exclusion: scDblFinder doublet AND strong distinct-lineage pair: >=3 genes each with >=2 UMIs in both panels, both panel means log1p(CP10k) >= max(reference positive q10, negative q99), smaller/larger panel mean >=.25. Reference-derived project heuristic, not validated doublet probability. Weak >=1-UMI pairs are diagnostic/trigger only and do not exclude cells.
identity: SingleR trained on adapted common genes from adult LV nuclear reference; fixed reference donors held out. Cell type assigned only with pruned reference label and >=2 matched panel genes; otherwise Unknown.
CM_core: Pruned and best reference label both Cardiomyocyte, >=2 CM genes, CM program >= every other panel, and (reference-tail pass OR >=3 CM genes and >=.5 CM-anchor neighbor support); no strong mixed programs. Identity core remains a released-barcode candidate, with no reconstructed ambient/nucleus call.
CM_pending: Strict numeric, no strong doublet exclusion; best reference CM OR >=3 CM genes and CM program dominates, but core rule fails. Pending candidates not forced into training.
graph: log1p(CP10k) copy; up to 3000 HVGs restricted to genes present in every released sample and excluding MT; <=40 PCs,15 exact neighbors. No disease/test labels. Correlated contextual support, not independent identity confidence.
light: At most 20000 unique core nuclei, balanced allocations across available donors with fixed seed, never duplicated to fill a target
split_status: No train/test split assigned; external cohort status pending donor-overlap audit
feature_space: Outer union of 37944 Ensembl IDs, not inner-join gene deletion. varm.feature_available_by_capture and uns.feature_availability_captures distinguish structural padding from measured zero; original feature axes saved separately. Graph uses only 32351 shared IDs; count objects preserve union.
replicate_policy: Chin donor identifiers are bound across series; none of these 9 IDs match the 13 prior Chin sample-table IDs, but this is not proof of independent biological provenance across all studies.
clinical_stage: 2 unused donor hearts,1 obstructive myectomy,6 end-stage nonobstructive HCM explants. Subtype/stage and sequencing-run fields preserved; not a balanced standalone binary cohort after strict QC.
scope: Each study saved separately. No disease differential expression, tokenization or training.
